title: BugDNA Fingerprint
description: Serialized representation of a BugDNA exception fingerprint

id.description: Deterministic fingerprint identifier prefixed with BUGDNA- followed by 16 uppercase hexadecimal characters

rootCause.description: Fully qualified class name (FQCN) of deepest root cause exception

signature.description: Origin frame signature formatted as SimpleClassName#methodName (or SimpleClassName if no stack trace)

qualifiedSignature.description: Fully qualified origin frame signature formatted as FQCN#methodName (or FQCN if no stack trace)

failureChain.description: Deduplicated architectural call flow using simple class names in call order (reversed stack)

causeChain.description: Exception class chain from outermost exception down to the root cause

stabilityScore.description: Confidence score based on stack depth (70, 90, 94, or 98)

category.description: Broad technical failure category derived from root-cause exception classification

family.description: Operational root-cause failure family used to cluster related fingerprints
